protocol.acquisition: Fresh game at fixed seed42, default Balanced/stage1. Before each of 20 starts choose highest score in each slot from already-owned items (later item wins ties). Queue finishThenCamp, advance one-second source pulses until town/defeat or 1000 pulses. Retain all losses/censors; no sales, grants, stats edits, AP, commissions, binding, IW, rerolls or extra attempts. Compare full state and reports with exact v031 after public actions/pulses.
protocol.replay: Unchanged canonical earned save loaded into candidate and v031 controller instances. Native DOM click/change/keydown/cancel dispatch under JSDOM plus deterministic source clock; complete state/RNG/action/storage-write parity at semantic checkpoints. Explicit simulated binding only for one separate naturally-earned investment branch; no real browser save.
protocol.limitation: Ordinary replay uses ephemeral unsupported-Web-Locks mode (preference writes tracked; no automatic progress saves). Separate explicit emulated-owned lock callback checks stored progress byte parity and a synthetic version999 protection boundary; neither is a real browser lock or cross-tab test. No browser, real Tab/Enter interaction, CSS geometry, screenshots, scroll/focus visibility, hosted deployment or actual production-save validation. JSDOM dialog show/close polyfills are an explicit emulation boundary.
